reference: Zheng et al., DiffusionNFT: Online Diffusion Reinforcement with Forward Process, ICLR 2026 (arXiv:2509.16117)
optimized_loss_component: FlowMol3 multi-modal flow-matching loss on coordinates, atom types, charges and bonds, evaluated on the implicit positive and negative policies
group_definition: Rewards are centred within a group, so only the ranking among candidates sharing a condition drives the update. FlowMol3 sampling is unconditional on GEOM-Drugs, so one rollout is one group by default.

hyperparameter_provenance.beta: Paper selects beta of 1 or 0.1 and reports 1 as the stable choice; Figure 10.
hyperparameter_provenance.soft_update: Paper uses eta_i = min(0.001 i, 0.5). This 1-stage baseline sets nft_iteration=1 so eta=0.001. The held-out evaluator still judges the trained policy, not the EMA collection snapshot.
hyperparameter_provenance.learning_rate_steps_batch: 1600 optimizer steps, learning rate 1e-4, and batch size 8 for the reward comparison.
hyperparameter_provenance.loss_weighting: FlowMol3's own multi-modal flow-matching weighting is retained.

parameterization_note: The paper is written for a velocity predictor. FlowMol3 predicts endpoints / velocities, so the implicit policies are formed on vector_field outputs without a score-to-velocity conversion.
claim_boundary: Optimizes the full-goal binary structural reward only when the rollout has reward variation.
